releaseNotes:
SAM 0.12.24 secures unattended Agent updates.

- Stage installers and logs under Program Files with a protected ACL allowing only SYSTEM and Administrators.
- Reject unexpected staging permissions and redirected staging directories.
- Keep the verified MSI locked against writes and replacement through installer launch; the private ACL continues protecting it when Windows Installer stops the service.
- Never use installers from the previous user-writable handoff directory.
- Use the system Windows Installer executable and preserve the payload if an installer wait is cancelled.

Validation: Agent regression tests, actual Windows staging ACL/inheritance checks, standard-user write denial, MSI version and embedded-payload verification. Full end-to-end service upgrade was not exercised in a disposable VM. Installer signing remains unchanged.
